string.text: Rest boosters (coffee, energy drinks, cocaine, epinephrine, cigarettes...) get weaker the more rest they gave you since your last sleep. Only rest you really received counts. Sleep removes the tolerance.
Master switch. Off: rest boosters work at full strength and nothing is shown. Your tolerance is kept.
Rest (in % of full rest) that boosters give at full strength after you wake up. After that they start to weaken. Higher = more full-strength doses per day.

Total rest (in % of full rest) boosters can give before sleep; at this point they stop working. Between the full-strength zone and this limit their effect falls linearly. Higher = longer without sleep.
Tolerance removed per hour of sleep (%)
Each hour of sleep removes this much tolerance (in % of full rest). 7.5 = the amount sleep restores per hour in G.A.M.M.A. Higher = a shorter sleep resets more.
Line in the tooltip of rest boosters: your stimulant tolerance and the item's effect right now. Tolerance 100% = boosters do nothing.
Current value in the Rest stat row
The Rest (Sleep) row in the item stats shows what the item gives right now instead of its full value.
Short on-screen text after you use a rest booster: the effect of the dose and your tolerance after it.
Writes every dose and sleep to the game log (Anomaly\appdata\logs) with the [STIM] tag.
